answer_1.quote: We evaluate on four diverse tasks from KILT: slot filling, question answering, fact checking and dialog.
answer_1.outputs: Slot fillers for T-REx, answers for Natural Questions and TriviaQA, SUPPORTS/REFUTES labels for FEVER, conversational responses for Wizard of Wikipedia.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy and (token-level) F1 measure the correctness of the generated output. For Wizard of Wikipedia, Rouge-L is used instead of accuracy... The metrics of KILT-Accuracy, KILT-F1 and, for Wizard of Wikipedia, KILT-Rouge-L are the underlying metric... for instances where R-Precision is one, otherwise zero.

answer_4.quote: We examined 20 instances coupled with 3 output texts: the baseline KGI 0 , Re^2 G, and the target text in the ground-truth. The three output texts were presented unlabeled and in random order to avoid bias. For each instance, we read the conversation history and then mark each text... Manual examination showed...
answer_4.guideline: Read the conversation history and mark each text for coherence or inconsistency relative to the conversation.
